text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 43 syringes of tirzepatide 2.5 mg/0.5 mL with a daily use of 4.2 syringes, providing 10.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA records as of 2026-10-21 show tirzepatide is not on the current shortage list; the earlier shortage first posted on 2022-12-15 has been resolved. No public FDA signal has been issued for the manufacturing plant associated with our supply.

Our position: Supply is limited to 10.3 days despite the resolved national shortage status. Replenishment timing is uncertain. Conservation is warranted until deliveries normalize.

Recommended actions:
1. Restrict new 2.5 mg starts to patients with documented intolerance to alternative GLP-1 agents; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Activate therapeutic interchange to semaglutide for appropriate existing patients; requires P&T Committee approval and medical staff notification.
3. Place emergency purchase orders with secondary distributors and verify allocation limits with the manufacturer; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Implement daily inventory tracking and twice-weekly supply updates to the committee; requires Pharmacy Buyer execution.

Not recommended: Initiating dose rounding or splitting of syringes; delaying elective bariatric surgery scheduling based solely on current inventory.
